prohibited_before_registration: gene or pathway selection from GSE234790 endpoint results
replacement of the primary published-cluster contrast
registration.event_blind_amendment: all 36,626 published-QC barcodes are retained; clusters 15, 17, and 18 are labeled other rather than omitted

hypothesis.primary: mature neuronal nuclei recurrently use more distal RNA 3-prime ends than Astro/NSC nuclei within the same donor
hypothesis.effect: mature_neuron minus astro_nsc distal usage index
hypothesis.global_pass: at least 7 of 8 donor median shifts are positive and the across-donor median is at least 0.02
hypothesis.forbidden_reselection: another cell contrast cannot replace the primary after endpoint inspection

catalogue.high_confidence: not internal-priming flagged and either same-strand PolyASite within 50 bp or canonical PAS motif 5-60 bp upstream with recurrence in at least 4 donors
catalogue.gene_assignment: unique same-strand GENCODE v49 gene window with 2000-bp transcript-oriented tail extension
catalogue.ambiguous_gene_window: report and exclude from primary analysis
catalogue.terminology_guard: alignment endpoint clusters are not called cleavage sites without tail or orthogonal support

inference.reported_gene: q <= 0.05, absolute mean effect >= 0.10, concordant sign in at least 6 donors, and no leave-one-donor-out mean sign reversal

accuracy.internal_priming: at least 12 A in downstream 20 nt or an 8-A run within downstream 140 nt, in transcript orientation
accuracy.required_separation: primary-site PolyASite match rate exceeds internal-priming-flagged-site match rate
accuracy.null: within-donor shuffled group labels; at most 5 percent q <= 0.05 and no global directional PASS
accuracy.tail_audit: measure before adding sparse sequence evidence; no format change is pre-authorized by this gate

alternative_last_exon.promotion: at least 100 genes with two recurrent terminal junction-to-site paths supported in at least 3 donors

performance.legacy_improvement: at least 2-fold wall-time or peak-RSS improvement over eight independent legacy apa-test reductions
performance.required_algorithm: one scan per archive, coordinate aggregation before site construction, no cell-by-site matrix

acceptance: strand-aware site ordering and motif checks
paired donor inference without cell or molecule pseudoreplication
